"""JLS 21 3.3 Unicode translation, with original UTF-8 byte provenance."""
import string

class UnicodeInputError(ValueError):
    def __init__(self,offset,message):
        self.offset=offset
        super().__init__(message)

def translate(text):
    units=[];offset=0;index=0;slashes=0;last_escape=False;count=0
    while index<len(text):
        char=text[index];start=offset;consumed=1;escaped=False
        if char=='\\' and (last_escape or slashes%2==0) and text[index+1:index+2]=='u':
            end=index+2
            while text[end:end+1]=='u':end+=1
            digits=text[end:end+4]
            if len(digits)!=4 or any(c not in string.hexdigits for c in digits):
                raise UnicodeInputError(start,'Invalid eligible Java Unicode escape')
            char=chr(int(digits,16));consumed=end+4-index;escaped=True;count+=1
        units.append((char,start))
        offset+=len(text[index:index+consumed].encode('utf-8'));index+=consumed
        slashes=slashes+1 if char=='\\' else 0
        last_escape=escaped
    result=[];positions=[];index=0
    while index<len(units):
        char,start=units[index];code=ord(char)
        if 0xD800<=code<=0xDBFF and index+1<len(units) and 0xDC00<=ord(units[index+1][0])<=0xDFFF:
            char=chr(0x10000+((code-0xD800)<<10)+ord(units[index+1][0])-0xDC00);index+=1
        elif 0xD800<=code<=0xDFFF:
            raise UnicodeInputError(start,'Unpaired Unicode surrogate requires UTF-16 token lowering')
        result.append(char);positions.extend([start]*len(char.encode('utf-8')));index+=1
    positions.append(len(text.encode('utf-8')))
    return ''.join(result),positions,count

def line_at(raw,offset):
    prefix=raw[:offset].replace(b'\r\n',b'\n').replace(b'\r',b'\n')
    return prefix.count(b'\n')+1

import sys,unittest,tempfile,subprocess,json,hashlib,os
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from translate_java import translate
from build_source_bundle import core_bundle,collect_sources
from workspace_paths import SCRIPTS_ROOT
from java_official_probe import REF,jars,run_with_dependencies
from harness import Package

class ApiWiring099(unittest.TestCase):
    def original(self,source):
        dependencies=jars(())
        version=json.loads((REF/'version.json').read_bytes())
        for lib in version['libraries']:
            artifact=lib.get('downloads',{}).get('artifact')
            if not artifact:continue
            path=Path('F:/PCL/.minecraft/libraries')/artifact['path']
            if path.is_file():
                self.assertEqual(hashlib.sha1(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),artifact['sha1'])
                dependencies.append(path)
        source=source.replace('import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;','').replace('Component.literal','wz.b').replace('Component.empty','wz.i').replace('Component c','wz c')
        source=source.replace('public class Run','class Run')
        return run_with_dependencies(source+' public class Probe {public static void main(String[] a){System.out.print(new Run().run());}}',dependencies)

    def compare(self,source,expected):
        self.assertEqual(self.original(source),expected)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root=Path(tmp);input=root/'input';input.mkdir();(input/'Run.java').write_text(source)
            report=translate(input,root/'out');self.assertEqual((report['generated_for_review'],report['manual_review'],report['failed']),(1,0,0),report)
            sources=core_bundle()['sources'];sources.update(collect_sources(root/'out/input'))
            pkg=Package();runtime=pkg.load('core.source_modules').SourceModuleLoader(sources)
            api=runtime.load('core.java_api');scope=api.JavaApiImports(runtime).install(api.collect_java_api())
            try:self.assertEqual(str(runtime.load('Run').Run().run()),expected)
            finally:scope.close();runtime.close()
            payload={'sources':sources,'loader_source':(SCRIPTS_ROOT/'core/source_modules.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'),'module':'Run','class_name':'Run','expected':expected}
            p=root/'probe.json';p.write_text(json.dumps(payload),encoding='utf-8')
            run=subprocess.run([r'D:\NeoCore工具\python27_validation\runtime\python.exe','-B',str(Path(__file__).with_name('probe_interfaces082_python27.py')),str(p)],capture_output=True,text=True)
            self.assertEqual(run.returncode,0,run.stdout+run.stderr)

    def test_literal_empty_get_string_java_original_python2_python3(self):
        self.compare('import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;public class Run {public int run(){Component c=Component.literal("abc");return c.getString().length()+Component.empty().getString().length();}}','3')

    def test_literal_null_and_receiver_null_match_original(self):
        self.compare('import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;public class Run {public int run(){int n=0;try{Component.literal(null);}catch(NullPointerException e){n++;}Component c=null;try{c.getString();}catch(NullPointerException e){n+=2;}return n;}}','3')

    def test_unreviewed_overloads_and_translatable_remain_blocked(self):
        for body in ['Component.literal(7);','Component.literal("a","b");','Component.empty(1);','Component.translatable("x");','Component.nullToEmpty("x");','Component c=null;c.literal("x");','Component c=null;c.empty();']:
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
                root=Path(tmp);(root/'Run.java').write_text('import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;class Run {void run(){'+body+'}}')
                report=translate(root,dry_run=True);self.assertEqual(report['manual_review'],1,report)

if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()

from workspace_paths import SCRIPTS_ROOT

SOURCE='''import net.neoforged.fml.ModContainer;import net.neoforged.fml.config.ModConfig;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.common.ModConfigSpec;
public class Run {public static void register(ModContainer c,ModConfigSpec s){
c.registerConfig(ModConfig.Type.COMMON,s);c.registerConfig(ModConfig.Type.CLIENT,s,"custom.toml");}}'''

KEY_SOURCE='''import net.neoforged.neoforge.registries.DeferredHolder;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceKey;
public class KeyRun {public static ResourceKey<Block> key(DeferredHolder<Block,Block> h){return h.getKey();}}'''

class ConfigWiring099(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_typed_config_registration_generated_python2_python3(self):
        known,stale=api_index();self.assertFalse(stale)
        code=generate(parse_source(SOURCE,known_types=known))['python_source']
        sources=core_bundle()['sources'];sources['Run']={'source':code,'origin':'Run.java'}
        probe='''from __future__ import print_function
import io,json,sys
with io.open(sys.argv[1],encoding='utf-8') as f:d=json.load(f)
scope={};eval(compile(d['loader'].encode('utf-8'),'loader.py','exec'),scope)
r=scope['SourceModuleLoader'](d['sources']);api=r.load('core.java_api');s=api.JavaApiImports(r).install(api.collect_java_api())
try:
 c=r.load('neoforge.config');b=c.ModConfigSpec.Builder();b.define('enabled',True);spec=b.build();container=c.ModContainer('sample')
 r.load('Run').Run.register(container,spec)
 assert len(container.getConfigs())==2
 assert container.getConfig(c.ModConfig.Type.COMMON).getFileName()=='sample-common.toml'
 assert container.getConfig(c.ModConfig.Type.CLIENT).getFileName()=='custom.toml'
 container.close();assert container.getConfigs()==[]
 print('CONFIG_WIRING099_PASS')
finally:s.close();r.close()
'''
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root=Path(tmp);p=root/'input.json';p.write_text(json.dumps(dict(sources=sources,loader=(SCRIPTS_ROOT/'core/source_modules.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))),encoding='utf-8');f=root/'probe.py';f.write_text(probe)
            for exe in (sys.executable,r'D:\NeoCore工具\python27_validation\runtime\python.exe'):
                r=subprocess.run([exe,'-B',str(f),str(p)],capture_output=True,text=True);self.assertEqual(r.returncode,0,r.stdout+r.stderr)

    def test_invalid_config_spec_type_and_unreviewed_constants_rejected(self):
        known,_=api_index()
        for source in (SOURCE.replace('Type.COMMON','Type.NOT_REAL'),SOURCE.replace('Type.COMMON,s','Type.COMMON,7'),SOURCE.replace('"custom.toml"','false')):
            with self.subTest(source=source),self.assertRaises(NeedsLowering):generate(parse_source(source,known_types=known))

    def test_fully_qualified_nested_identity_reuses_only_known_export(self):
        known,_=api_index()
        ir=parse_source(SOURCE,known_types=known)
        self.assertIn('net.neoforged.fml.config.ModConfig.Type',generate(ir)['required_api_types'])
        bad=SOURCE.replace('ModConfig.Type.COMMON','ModConfig.Unknown.COMMON')
        with self.assertRaises(NeedsLowering):generate(parse_source(bad,known_types=known))

    def test_reviewed_ancestry_shared_by_overloads_and_generic_bounds(self):
        from java_generic_contracts import proves_bound
        from java_method_overloads import subtype
        spec='net.neoforged.neoforge.common.ModConfigSpec';contract='net.neoforged.fml.config.IConfigSpec'
        self.assertTrue(subtype(spec,contract,{},{}))
        self.assertTrue(proves_bound(spec,contract,{},{}))
        self.assertFalse(subtype('java.lang.String',contract,{},{}))
        self.assertFalse(proves_bound('java.lang.String',contract,{},{}))
        known,_=api_index()
        bad='import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceKey;import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;class Run {ResourceKey<String> wrong(ResourceKey<Block> key){return key;}}'
        with self.assertRaises(NeedsLowering):generate(parse_source(bad,known_types=known))
        # A provider method name alone is not an equivalence proof. The legacy
        # holder returns its registry key, not the Java entry key, so keep the
        # call blocked until a separate corrected provider is reviewed.
        with self.assertRaises(NeedsLowering):generate(parse_source(KEY_SOURCE,known_types=known))

import sys,tempfile,unittest
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from translate_java import translate
from java_entity_signatures import contextual_factory_return,DEFERRED_ITEM,ITEM

class TargetFactory099(unittest.TestCase):
    def probe(self,body):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root=Path(tmp)
            (root/'Child.java').write_text('import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;public class Child extends Item {public Child(){super(new Item.Properties());}}')
            (root/'Run.java').write_text('import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;import net.neoforged.neoforge.registries.DeferredItem;import net.neoforged.neoforge.registries.DeferredRegister;class Run {static DeferredRegister.Items ITEMS=DeferredRegister.createItems("test");'+body+'}')
            result=translate(root,dry_run=True)
            return next(r for r in result['results'] if r['file']=='Run.java')

    def test_target_infers_parent_item_without_erasing_holder(self):
        row=self.probe('static DeferredItem<Item> VALUE=ITEMS.register("one",()->new Child());')
        self.assertEqual(row['status'],'GENERATED_REVIEW_REQUIRED',row)

    def test_existing_invariant_holder_does_not_become_covariant(self):
        row=self.probe('static DeferredItem<Item> wrong(DeferredItem<Child> old){return old;}')
        self.assertEqual(row['status'],'MANUAL_REVIEW',row)
        self.assertIn('invariant',row['reason'])

    def test_factory_cannot_narrow_or_cross_the_declared_bound(self):
        for body in ['static DeferredItem<Child> VALUE=ITEMS.register("one",()->new Item(new Item.Properties()));',
                     'static DeferredItem<String> VALUE=ITEMS.register("one",()->"bad");']:
            self.assertEqual(self.probe(body)['status'],'MANUAL_REVIEW')
        record=dict(return_type=DEFERRED_ITEM+'<Child>',target_factory_bound=ITEM)
        self.assertIsNone(contextual_factory_return(record,DEFERRED_ITEM+'<String>',lambda a,b:a==b))
        self.assertIsNone(contextual_factory_return({},DEFERRED_ITEM+'<'+ITEM+'>',lambda a,b:True))

    def test_diamond_keeps_context_and_explicit_arguments_remain_invariant(self):
        import test_interfaces082 as oracle
        oracle.Interfaces082().compare({'use/Run.java':'package use;import java.util.Map;import java.util.HashMap;public class Run {public int run(){Map<String,String> m=new HashMap<>();m.put("k","abc");return m.get("k").length();}}'},'3')
        for body in ['java.util.List<String> a=new java.util.ArrayList<Integer>();','java.util.Map<String,String> a=new java.util.HashMap<Integer,String>();']:
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
                root=Path(tmp);(root/'Run.java').write_text('class Run {void run(){'+body+'}}')
                # Different erased implementation/interface names continue to
                # use the existing strict collection constructor contracts.
                report=translate(root,dry_run=True)
                self.assertEqual(report['manual_review'],1,report)

if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()
